summary: Verified SEO/SSR behavior for Dynopay: help center article bodies (7 slugs), JSON-LD schemas on /fees and /for/* (including the newly-added SoftwareApplication+Offer), multilingual ?lang= SSR (fr/de/es/nl/pt), and English self-canonical. Created /app/tests/seo_ssr_test.py with 26 pytest cases inspecting RAW curl SSR HTML (before JS hydration). All 26 tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor schema.org nit: /fees Service JSON-LD nests the OfferCatalog under `offers` instead of the canonical `hasOfferCatalog` property. Google still parses it, but `hasOfferCatalog` is the schema.org-recommended property for Service->OfferCatalog. Non-blocking.

hreflang attribute is emitted as `hrefLang` (camelCase) — this is valid because React/Next serializes it and browsers/crawlers are case-insensitive on HTML attributes, but human inspection of view-source may look inconsistent.
